items.headline: The Steelers last won in Philadelphia in 1965. Can they top an Eagles team on 7-game losing streak?
items.description: — Perhaps the Steelers should have stayed attached at the hip pads with the Eagles — as they were when they merged for the 1943 season to form the Steagles — to avoid such an ignominious losing streak in Philadelphia.
